name: EntityInspector
description: Inspect any entity: identity, attributes, gear and skill book. Adds an 'Inspect' item to CombatMeter rows and a magnifier button to the profile card.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Gear tab — weapon card plus armor and accessory grids.

added: New "Show Weapon" option in the character preview — keep the weapon out of the 3D portrait, or turn it back on. Hidden by default.
changed: The character preview is brighter and more vivid, and no longer shifts colour with wherever your character is standing — the model looks the same every time you open it.
Tidier inspector header: the name and class now sit together on one line, above an easier-to-read health bar.
Requires framework 2.8.3 or newer. On an older framework you'll keep the previous version of the plugin instead of an incompatible one.
